meta.name: genomic-intelligence
meta.description: Predict regulatory features, gene structure, and expression directly from DNA sequence using Genomic Intelligence's hosted transformer DNA language models — no local GPU or model weights. Six tasks over a REST API and a hosted MCP server (keyless public demo): promoter regions, splice donor/acceptor sites, enhancer activity, chromatin state, sequence-to-expression (log TPM), and de-novo gene annotation, plus a composite find-genes-then-predict-expression workflow. Use when the user has a gene symbol, a genomic region, or a DNA/FASTA sequence and wants any of these predictions, mentions Genomic Intelligence, genomicintelligence.ai, api.genomicintelligence.ai, or mcp.genomicintelligence.ai.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入基因名或一段 DNA 序列,直接预测启动子、剪接位点、增强子活性和表达量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有基因符号或 DNA 序列,想快速拿到调控与表达层面的预测结果
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a gene symbol or DNA sequence and want quick regulatory and expression predictions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把基因符号、基因组区域或 DNA/FASTA 序列提交给 Genomic Intelligence 的托管服务器，拿回启动子、剪接位点、增强子活性、染色质状态、表达量（log TPM）和基因注释等预测结果；本地不需要 GPU 或模型权重。
howto.when: 当你有基因符号、基因组区域或 DNA/FASTA 序列并想做这类预测，或提到 Genomic Intelligence、genomicintelligence.ai、mcp.genomicintelligence.ai 等时触发。

say.text: 帮我预测这段 DNA 序列里的启动子区域
say.note: 走 promoter 任务，返回滑动窗口启动子区间。

say.text: 标出这段序列的剪接供体和受体位点
say.note: 走 splice 任务；序列需按转录方向提供。

say.text: 用 K562 细胞预测这个基因的表达量 log TPM

howto.what_en: Claude sends a gene symbol, genomic region, or DNA/FASTA sequence to Genomic Intelligence's hosted servers and gets back promoters, splice sites, enhancer activity, chromatin state, expression (log TPM), and gene annotation — no local GPU.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have a gene symbol, a genomic region, or a DNA/FASTA sequence and want these predictions, or mention Genomic Intelligence, genomicintelligence.ai, or mcp.genomicintelligence.ai.

say_en.text: Predict the promoter regions in this DNA sequence
say_en.note: Runs the promoter task and returns sliding-window regions.

say_en.text: Find the splice donor and acceptor sites in this sequence
say_en.note: Runs the splice task; feed transcript orientation.

say_en.text: Predict expression in K562 cells for this gene
say_en.note: Expression needs a 9,198 bp TSS-centred window and a cell-type description.
